info.title: SQE Ticket Management
info.description: Contract for PR #5 fixed revision bec9c208 with default settings and the optional 12-character asset fixture. JSON API and customer intake only. DELETE, editing follow-ups, user provisioning, attachment management routes and deployment-specific custom fields are outside the selected operations. Session mutations require Django CSRF; Basic uses staff/customer credentials. The format renderer is exercised on reads as a shared transport setting. Read-only submitted properties are ignored; application deviations are recorded in the test evidence.
